fusions.name: Slam the Door
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Points
fusions.desc: A ring of blade points rises around you and deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, leaving them [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Driven Palisade
fusions.desc: Drives a line of blades 5 tiles long into the ground for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Held in Check
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
